name: – Ingeborg Ter Laak – Article 1, after § 2 – Am 21
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council suspending the application of the rules on the appointment of an authorised representative for extended producer responsibility for batteries and waste batteries and packaging and packaging waste
part_text: Micro and small enterprises. within the meaning of Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC, which are established in a Member State shall be permanently exempt from the obligation to appoint an authorised representative for extended producer responsibility pursuant to Article 56(3) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 when making batteries available to end-users in another Member State by means of cross-border distance sales. The other obligations of producers relating to extended producer responsibility shall remain unaffected.
